text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Spread out... Spread out...
Please... open up a lane...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
The final straight has the widest course width, right?
In that case... this is how it's done...!

The pinnacle festival, the "Japanese Derby."
Never did I imagine that day would arrive
at the absolute worst timing.

Unless there is a withdrawal, it is impossible for the Japanese Derby
not to have a full gate.
And as for the current Tamamo Cross...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, my bad.
Ending up like this...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
My desire to win hasn't changed one bit!
Even so, when everyone runs as one big pack...

There's no telling what the result will be.
But right now, what's important is—
choice_data_list: Just being able to qualify is impressive enough.
Just being able to enter is an achievement in itself.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Admirable...?
Even when I couldn't run worth a damn?
choice_data_list: Yeah, you made it into the generation's top 18.
Yeah, after all, you made it into the top 18 of our generation.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
18 runners...
Now that you mention it, yeah...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
A dropout like me made it all the way to the Derby...
That alone is definitely something, but...
choice_data_list: Let's show your family what you can do.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"...Right. Right about now, everyone
must be glued to the TV back home."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Even if I lose, I don't wanna show myself cowering on the big stage.
I... I'm...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I'll do it, I'll do it, I'll do it...!
I'll give it... the best run I've got!"

I managed to encourage her somehow.
For now, this was the best I could do.
All we could do was bet on sheer determination. With a prayer in my heart, I sent her off toward the great zelkova tree at Fuchu.
